## Description

Mobile versions: Today (6/15 seen, next patient, critical items), Capture (REC, waveform, chunks uploaded, screen stays on), Note review (field cards, swipe right to accept, tap to edit, evidence bottom sheet with 6 s secure replay, "Sign note (n unresolved)" pinned), Appointments agenda, Patient record with sticky banner. Wearable pairing frame is P6.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** All listed mobile frames work at 360–430 px with 48 px targets and sticky identity banner.
- [ ] **AC2.** Swipe-to-accept has an accessible alternative (button) for keyboard/screen-reader users.
- [ ] **AC3.** Sign stays pinned above the tab bar and disabled until 0 unresolved.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
